actions.reason: b58encode recomputed per-alphabet constants on every call (len(alphabet), base**2, base**4, alphabet[0:1]) next to a cached pair-table lookup. A new memoised helper _get_base58_encode_tables returns (pairs, base**2, base**4, zero char) together, so one cache lookup and a tuple unpack replace the per-call arithmetic and slicing. The digit loop is unchanged, outputs are byte-identical (equivalence harness passes), and b58encode_int and the public API are untouched. Measured encode_ir ratio 0.9876; decode_ir 0.9948 and check_ir 0.9949 also improve slightly through the shared encode path.
